title: PriFT: Guiding Supervised Fine-Tuning with Pretrained Priors
abstract: arXiv:2606.09396v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is an efficient approach for downstream task adaptation and often serves as the initialization stage for reinforcement learning (RL), but it can show weaker generalization than RL. A key limitation is its off-policy objective: SFT fits fixed demonstrations token by token, including targets poorly aligned with the model's pretrained distribution, which can lead to overfitting. A recent line of work addresses this issue by assigning larger training weights to tokens better aligned with the current model's predictive distribution, with the intuition that fitting these tokens are less distortive to the model's knowledge and representations. However, computing the token weights from the model that is currently fine-tuned entangles token weights with the optimization trajectory, inducing a self-reinforcing loop which concentrates the supervision signal to a narrow set of initially preferred tokens. translated_title: PriFT：利用预训练先验指导有监督微调
translated_abstract: 有监督微调（SFT）是一种高效的下游任务适配方法，并常作为强化学习（RL）的初始化阶段，但其泛化能力可能弱于强化学习。一个关键局限在于其离策略目标：SFT 逐 token 地拟合固定的示范数据，其中包含与模型预训练分布不一致的目标，容易导致过拟合。近期一系列工作试图解决这一问题，其做法是为与当前模型预测分布更一致的 token 分配更大的训练权重，其直觉是拟合这些 token 对模型已有知识和表征的破坏较小。然而，若从正在被微调的模型本身计算 token 权重，会使 token 权重与优化轨迹相互纠缠，形成自我强化的循环，使监督信号集中到模型最初偏好的狭窄 token 集合上。（注：原文摘要至此处被截断，后续内容未能提供。）
tldr: 提出 PriFT 方法，以冻结的预训练模型先验而非正在微调的模型来计算 token 训练权重，避免权重与优化轨迹纠缠所引发的自我强化循环，从而提升有监督微调的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: PriFT computes token training weights from a frozen pretrained prior rather than the model being fine-tuned, breaking the self-reinforcing loop that entangles token weights with the optimization trajectory and thereby improving the generalization of supervised fine-tuning.
